meta.title: AI Governance Radar
meta.geographic_scope: 193 UN members + State of Palestine + Holy See
meta.geography_note: Visible cartography is the United Nations Clear Map WebDark raster, reprojected locally from Web Mercator into spherical Equal Earth. The September 2026 UN Correct the Map resolution encourages Equal Earth and other equal-area projections; this local rendering is not a newly issued official UN map. The radar is anchored at the projected world centre, 0 degrees latitude and longitude. Source raster polar caps beyond 85.0511 degrees are not covered. Country interaction/fill polygons use simplified Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 Countries, not official UN boundary data, and can differ from visible UN cartography. All 195 countries are represented. Flags are embedded SVG images from the MIT-licensed flag-icons collection, version 7.5.0.
meta.evidence_policy: Only located official sources are listed. Source location is distinguished from document-level metadata review. Null values mean unverified; missing records do not establish absence.
meta.regional_policy: EU records stored once and inherited by 27 Member States. Other regional layers browsable without assumed national adoption.
meta.source_check_policy: Automated GET checks assess accessibility only, not correctness or current legal status.
meta.change_policy: Every change is logged as a dated event. World events (published, revised, consultation, adopted, applied, superseded, repealed) record government actions; radar events (added, corrected, removed, link) record changes to this database. Automatically detected events stay marked 'needs review' until confirmed against the official source.
